newsitem.title: USA: U.S. T-bond futures fall on U.S. productivity data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. T-bond futures fall on U.S. productivity data.

text.p: May 7 - U.S. T-bond futures fell below Tuesday's low to 109-20/32 on prelim 1997 Q1 productivity data. Unit labor costs rose 2.7 pct, while productivity was up 2.0 pct for the biggest gain since Q4 1993. One dealer sold 3,000 June bonds. In Euros, dealers sold 3,000 Sept and about 700 Dec. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
